source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    frame = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 5]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in frame)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in frame)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in frame)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in frame)
    rmid = (r0 + r1) / 2
    cmid = (c0 + c1) / 2
    colors = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value not in (0, 5) and not (r0 <= r <= r1 and c0 <= c <= c1):
                q = (0 if r < rmid else 1, 0 if c < cmid else 1)
                colors[q] = value
                colors[(1 - q[0], 1 - q[1])] = value
    for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
            q = (0 if r < rmid else 1, 0 if c < cmid else 1)
            out[r][c] = colors[q]
    return out
'''
